stage0044a_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$敷島$$
「Well then, $$シモン$$, $$タケル$$... I'm counting on you.」

stage0044a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$シモン$$
「Leave it to me, Dr. $$敷島$$.」

stage0044a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But I was surprised, though.
　That the doctor investigated an alien civilization.」

stage0044a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$敷島$$
「In some of the rocks in this asteroid field,
　traces of artificial construction were found,
　so I was asked to look into it.」

stage0044a_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$マッキー$$
「So Dad and the others found something that fit,
　but the rock was too hard to dig through.」

stage0044a_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マッキー$$
「I'm so glad $c was nearby,
　it really helped.」

stage0044a_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So, why is $$マッキー$$ with the survey team too?」

stage0044a_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Because chances to go to space are so rare.
　So I asked Dad to bring me along.」

stage0044a_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Tch... here I am in space for work,
　must be nice for some people.」

stage0044a_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Now, now, it's fine, $$ワッ太$$.
　We're just stopping by on our way back to Earth.」

stage0044a_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Besides, the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$
　has all the research facilities we need.」

stage0044a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$敷島$$
「Thank you, $$田中司令$$.
　I'll take you up on that.」

stage0044a_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$タケル$$
「So this is the rock Dr. $$敷島$$ mentioned.」

stage0044a_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$タケル$$, use your sight to see through the rock.
　If you can tell something's inside, I'll dig it
　out with my drill after that.」

stage0044a_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$タケル$$
「...10 meters to the right...
　about 12 meters in, there's something artificial...
　It looks like a box, about 2 meters across.」

stage0044a_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$シモン$$
「Alright...!
　Leave the rest to me!」

stage0044a_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Amazing! That's amazing!
　As expected of our digging champ!」

stage0044a_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「The title of the guy at the top of our Digging Trio.」

stage0044a_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Huh... three brothers...?
　Isn't there one extra person now?」

stage0044a_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Eldest, me... second, $$アマタ$$... third, $$ジン$$.」

stage0044a_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ジン$$
「Since when am I part of this!?」

stage0044a_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't be so uptight about it.
　The Digging Trio has a better ring to it,
　so I added a member.」

stage0044a_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's great, $$ジン$$.
　Good luck... digging.」

stage0044a_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（You're actually going along with that!?）

stage0044a_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（$$ユノハ$$'s power really is incredible）

stage0044a_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$敷島$$
「How's it going, $$シモン$$, $$タケル$$?」

stage0044a_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$シモン$$
「Just like $$タケル$$ said, we found the box.」

stage0044a_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$タケル$$
「It looks like some kind of capsule, but...」

stage0044a_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$タケル$$
「Dr. $$敷島$$!
　There's a person, a child, inside the capsule!」
